label: Power: a power for a proposition versus an active power of a being
resolution: POWER_FOR_VERSUS_ACTIVE_POWER_1 is PowerFor (DEF bf7eddca-8291-4744-8470-379babcd7781): at w, y could initiate a causal chain issuing in a proposition p; it is the power of #1897's holder for the joint absence of the actual contingent concreta. POWER_FOR_VERSUS_ACTIVE_POWER_2 is an active power of the agency overlay (PowerOf, exercised in a giving; DEF 582f44c3-7778-4806-b385-e1eff852ac5e). They are separate primitives and nothing identifies them: nothing says that a power for an outcome is one of the holder's active powers, or that exercising an active power realizes a power for a proposition. The only premise of the batch whose antecedent is in sense 1 and whose consequent is in sense 2 is 9856239a-aef9-4b87-b70a-15a3176d6dd7 ('Whatever has power for the actual contingents' joint absence has one power'); argument B reaches its sense-2 conclusion through it together with 813a9181-8cce-45a0-a3f1-ad8cd2b281c6 and 5c1aba17-d224-49fd-a31c-728a54ac63a9, and lists it as its sense bridge. It says how many active powers whatever holds PowerFor has, without identifying the two kinds of power. Sense 1 is carried by the PowerFor parameter (lean_parameters); PowerFor is a binder, not a declaration, and the listed declaration ModalGrounding.AristotelianGroundingFor only hosts it. Sense 2 is the PowerOf field of the agency overlay. The holder premises of the will-versus-chance batch use PowerFor only to pick out the holder; the one-power premise (OnePower) and the rationality of a power concern PowerOf only.
